record_kind: Sanitized derived historical facts, not original transcripts

routes.data_scope: 30 finite synthetic tool cases with assessor-prescribed ROI/carrier/orientation/loop supports; no model blind run, specimen, calibration or instrument qualification
routes.noise: One deterministic replicate each: no noise; iid additive Gaussian sigma/clean contrast RMS=1 and3; pure-noise controls use absolute sigma1 and3. No clipping, Poisson dose, scan distortion or measured SNR.
physics_limits: Twin cosine and continuum defect textures are not atomistic or multislice image simulations.

Multiphase means explicit structurally distinct model cells projected as Gaussian Z-weighted independent atoms, not verified experimental phases. Cu a4A and Fe a3.2A are deliberately declared synthetic model metrics.
FCC/BCC hard seam and linear overlap do not simulate coherent interface relaxation, thickness-dependent/dynamical scattering or HRTEM CTF.
ROI boundaries, carrier vectors, scale, orientation and loops are supplied by assessor truth. Autonomous localization/ROI choice/phase search/defect diagnosis remain NOT_TESTED.

One noise realization per condition, bin-centered periodic signals, fixed calibration/registration and no sub-bin refinement. Tiny geometric residuals are grid agreement, not uncertainty or general accuracy.
16-peak catalog cap can truncate higher reflections; unmatched simulated reflections and coverage retained. Friedel pairs and same-image processing are not independent experiments.
Overlapping-component sources can be incompatible with every pure reference; no general multiphase segmentation/unmixing capability demonstrated.
No GUI acceptance, fresh Agent cognition, API model performance, real specimen, native DM, Linux/Mac or instrument qualification.

first_failures.outcome: fetch failed after prior numerical/export/recovery work; cause unqualified

routes.decision: Keep numerical known-support evidence separate from autonomous research performance.
routes.reproduce: Controlled archive member create_complex_data.py plus preregister.json and source receipts; never replay incomplete originals.

findings: Clean reciprocal-cosine twin geometry: independently separated halves, about0.23096 synthetic nm; did not confirm a material twin.
Noisy Gaussian projected FCC/BCC proxy: about0.20025 vs0.22599 synthetic nm and45degree change; pure fixed-scale rotation insufficient, no chemical phase identification.
Clean contrast-only vortex: stable8pixel carrier and broadening; did not determine winding/Burgers vector or locate physical core.
Groups B/C produced measurements but no final analysis by780seconds.
routes.first_attempts: First A configuration failure retained separately; group count is not asserted to be all launch attempts.
limits: Explicitly supplied public Skills, not automatic plugin/Skill discovery qualification.
General neutral research question; no forced diagnosis or method chain.
No statistical accuracy, sensitivity, false-positive rate or noise robustness inferred from7 selected images and4 sessions.
Successful numerical measurements and cautious interpretations do not establish unique phase/3D twin/physical-dislocation identification.
No before/after baseline model comparison, so causation of any GUI-related AI regression is unproven.
Raw CLI stderr contains routine account telemetry; use this redacted summary for sharing.
routes.blindness_status: Input/prompt separation recorded in original assessment; do not retroactively infer stronger isolation from disabled feature flags.
routes.reproduce: Controlled frozen public-input packet, allowed-tool/Skill manifest, original runner and assessor; new sessions are stochastic and not original-request recovery.

routes.limits: Backend latency decomposition and original second-helper exit trace unavailable; do not infer a single root cause.

routes.decision: Repair only confirmed helper startup observation, not assign all780seconds to one cause.

routes.data: Same four frozen synthetic inputs across original unfinished B/C groups, one Gaussian seed where noisy.
findings: B/C reruns completed; source scale/carrier and mirror-related geometry were measured conditionally.
No autonomous GPA/topology/structure/twin-comparison qualification was established.
B did not open Panel whereas C used the repaired path, so aggregate speed cannot be attributed solely to this repair.
limits: Original B/C were right-censored at780s, not completed baselines. No controlled aggregate speedup estimate.
Fresh stochastic sessions/backend load differ; B never opened a Panel, C exercised the fixed path. Total time improvement cannot be assigned solely to this fix.
Model RPC duration includes transport/backend queue/inference/streaming; TTFT and token counts do not separate all components.
Four same frozen synthetic inputs, one noisy seed each; no real-specimen validation or statistical robustness claim.
No autonomous GPA/topology/structure/twin comparison in these reruns; advanced ability remains unverified.
Scientific review performed by executing agent against frozen truth and saved measurements; no additional independent scoring-model session.
routes.decision: Include bounded operational recovery in the engineering baseline; retain original censored runs and stochastic reruns as distinct records.
routes.reproduce: Controlled original public-input hashes, candidate identity, run settings and assessor artifacts; not a controlled performance effect estimate.

recording_note: Compiled retrospectively from preserved evidence. This compilation is not a contemporaneous preregistration or a new experiment.
